newsitem.title: UK: Rentokil shares drop in heavy trading.
newsitem.headline: Rentokil shares drop in heavy trading.

text.p: Shares in Rentokil Plc retreated in heavy trading on Friday from yesterday's record peak as brokerage SBC Warburg placed 7.5 million shares on behalf of an unidentified institutional investor, market sources said.
The stock was down 10p at 432 by 1505 GMT, with volume reaching 16.7 million shares -- making it the second most active FTSE 100 stock.
Traders said the shares were placed at 432p as one institution took profits on the recent strength in the stock, up 30p in the past five trading sessions.
Rentokil has risen sharply in recent months and by yesterday's close was up 31.5 percent since the end of 1995.
